rationale: FX01 fires only when a non-USD source par requires explicit USD conversion. The raw schedule of investments uses a Par Amount column with dollar signs on the debt schedule, and the adjacent geographic breakdown reports the portfolio as 100% United States. The source therefore does not support the non-USD premise behind the FX01 rows; the missing principal_amount_usd field under this rule is a check-scope false alarm rather than a data error.
